_note: The TRAINING GROUP's moments (session P1, GDD 4.9.5; format in README.md). Senders: partner (the close training partners, data/cast.json partners) or partner:<role> (joker, racer, veteran, newcomer, quiet, leader, talker: coaching.json club.group.roles), teammate (anyone in the coach's group). They change with the coach (a new group comes with a new coach). Session L3a (the sort, docs/L3_SORT.md, user 2026-10-25): FEED messages that ask nothing (a teammate's memory of you is story state in `effects`), two INVITATIONS (watching the big meets at the clubhouse). No line claims a session the player's plan does not have: a text about today's or tomorrow's session is guarded by its tags. Ages 14-16 (P2 adds 16-17). All teammates are fictional.

text: Hey, you're the new one in {coach_first}'s group. I'm {from}. Warm-ups are more fun with company: I'm the one with the orange hat.
Welcome to the group! Tip: never stand next to {coach_first} while the reps are being counted. You'll get an extra one.
Hard session today. I've already written my will. You can have my spikes.
Rumour: {coach_first} is adding two reps today. Any day really.
I dreamt today's session was cancelled. Then I woke up.
-17 this morning. My eyelashes froze. And we're running outside.
The weather forecast says 'stay indoors'. {coach_first} says 'tights and a buff'.
I beat you on the last rep today. Just saying.
Everything is a competition. Today's last rep was mine.
Score so far: me 7, you 4. Last reps only. You're counting too, admit it.
OK, you won the last rep today. It doesn't count, I had a stitch.
Big meet coming. At my first Nuorten SM I threw up in the call room. Then I ran a PB. So, you know.
Advice for {meet}: warm up early, don't watch the other heats, and eat something an hour before.
You were limping a bit today. I ignored that at your age and lost a whole summer.
Something's sore, I can tell. That's how my stress fracture started. Don't be a hero.
I still can't do the A-skip. I look like a broken giraffe. Watching you helps.
I'm always this tired after an 'easy' run. Please say that's normal.
My mum bought me a ski jacket for winter training. I look like a marshmallow.

text.text: I ran my first race without dying! Copying you in warm-ups worked.

text: {coach_first} said my drills look better. Finally.
Long run tomorrow. Same pace as last time. I don't talk much, you know that.
Tomorrow's long run: the forest loop. Quiet is good.
Tomorrow's reps: I'll lead the first half, you take the second.
I'll set the pace tomorrow. You just hang on.
Big news: {teammate} might switch to the 400. And {coach_first} was on the phone forever after practice. Something's going on.
OMG, {teammate} got new spikes, the bright green ones. They cost like a phone.
Don't say anything, but I think {coach_first} is getting a new group from the other club.
My mum is driving to {meet}. There's a seat for you if you need one.
Going to {meet} by car, leaving early. The back seat is yours if you want it.
PB!! I saw the results. {coach_first} was smiling, which is rare.
{pb}! Now I have to train harder. Thanks a lot.
Rough one today. Happens to everyone. I DNF'd at my first indoor race.
Don't look at the time too long. Next session, we go again.
Bad news: stress fracture. Six weeks off. I'm going crazy already.
I rolled my ankle on the trail. Crutches for a week. Send me what we did in practice.

invite.title: Kalevan kisat at the clubhouse on {weekday}?

text: Kalevan kisat this weekend! The 800 m final is on TV on {weekday}. Watch it together at the clubhouse?
The national champs on TV! Group viewing at my place on {weekday}, the 800 m finals. Bring snacks.

replies.label: I'll watch at home
replies.result: Live chat during the final then.

invite.title: Finland v Sweden at the clubhouse on {weekday}?

text: Ruotsi-ottelu this weekend! Finland against Sweden. The whole club is watching in the clubhouse on {weekday}.
Finnkampen! We HAVE to beat Sweden this year. Watching it together on {weekday}?

replies.label: Hyvä Suomi!
replies.result: Blue and white face paint, compulsory.

text: Base training again. Long runs, hills, and darkness at five.
New season, new us. This year I'm going under 2:10. Write it down.
It's my birthday this week. I'm bringing cake to practice. Don't say anything to {coach_first}, or we'll all be running it off.
My mum made a birthday cake for the group. The biggest piece is yours.
The Pajulahti camps for 7-9 graders look amazing. A whole week with real coaches. My parents say it's expensive.
I heard the TF-juniorit coaches come to the big meets to watch. Imagine getting picked.
Dark at three o'clock. Headlamps on today, and stay on the lit trail.
I can't remember the last time I saw the sun after school. Running in the dark again.
Indoor season! The hall smells of rubber and nerves.
The indoor bends are so tight. My elbows are ready.
Today's session. My calves are writing a complaint.
I could only feel my legs for the first half of today's reps.
That moose on the long run! It just stood there looking at us.
Long run today and a deer ran across the path right in front of me. My heart rate is still up.
It's {coach_first}'s birthday this week! We're getting a card and a cake. I put your name on the card.
Secret: we're singing for {coach_first} after a session this week. Birthday.
